verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's official CLI documents its own `scrapingbee crawl` command for same-domain, sitemap, or Scrapy-spider crawls. That is first-party crawl capability, but the evidence never mentions a breadth-first traversal strategy or a configurable maximum page limit. missing for 10: documented breadth-first crawl strategy, configurable max-page/depth limit parameters, in-depth crawl documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of deep crawling.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can run a deep crawl using a breadth-first strategy with a configurable maximum page limit

citations.quote: `scrapingbee crawl` | Quick same-domain crawl, sitemap crawl, or Scrapy-project spider.
Use the official ScrapingBee command-line interface for scraping, crawling, exports, schedules, and dedicated APIs.
